en.title: Fertility and IVF Counseling in Schaumburg, IL
en.description: Emotional support during infertility and IVF with Dr. Jelena Djurovic. Sessions in English and Serbian in Schaumburg and online while clients are in Illinois.
en.intro: Waiting for a result, deciding whether to try again, or talking with a partner who wants something different can be hard to manage alongside work and everyday life. Dr. Jelena Djurovic offers individual and couples therapy for fertility-related concerns at Center for PTA in Schaumburg.

sections.title: What to bring to therapy
sections.text: Some conversations are about a specific result or loss. Others are about feeling exhausted by treatment, blaming yourself, or not knowing what to tell family. You don’t need to wait until treatment is over to ask for support.

sections.title: Do I need to bring my partner?
sections.text: No. You can ask for individual therapy even if you and your partner are going through treatment together. Couples sessions focus on the relationship, including arguments that keep repeating or disagreements about continuing treatment. When you get in touch, say whether you want to attend alone or together.

sections.title: Getting started
sections.text: In your first message, briefly describe what you’d like help with and ask about appointments. You don’t need to send a detailed treatment history. Before booking, discuss the type of sessions you’re looking for and any questions about fees or insurance.

sections.title: Sessions in English or Serbian
sections.text: Sessions are available in English and Serbian at 1320 Tower Rd, Suite 156, Schaumburg, IL 60173. For telehealth, everyone joining must be physically in Illinois during the session. The practice will also discuss whether online sessions are appropriate for your needs.

sections.title: Fees, insurance and medical care
sections.text: Check the rates and insurance page, then confirm your psychotherapy coverage with the office and your insurer. Insurance that covers fertility treatment may have different terms for therapy. Questions about medical treatment or medication should go to your fertility team.

en.guideTitle: Choosing emotional support during fertility treatment
en.guideIntro: Before booking, ask about the therapist’s experience, fees and how sessions work. These five questions can help you prepare for that conversation.

questions.title: What experience do you have with fertility-related concerns?
questions.text: Describe what you need help with, such as coping with treatment, a loss or strain in your relationship. Ask whether the therapist works with those concerns and how they would approach them.

questions.title: Can I come on my own?
questions.text: Check whether the therapist offers individual therapy, couples therapy or both. If you plan to begin alone and later invite your partner, ask how that would affect the sessions and confidentiality.

questions.title: Can we work in the language I prefer?
questions.text: Confirm the language before booking. For online therapy, also ask which states the therapist can work with clients in and whether online sessions are appropriate for you.

questions.title: What will it cost, and when could we begin?
questions.text: Ask the price per session, whether your specific insurance plan covers it, and how much you would pay yourself. Check the first available appointment and the cancellation policy.

questions.title: What happens in the first session?
questions.text: Ask whether you need to prepare anything. If you would like the therapist to speak with your fertility clinic, ask what consent is needed and what information would be shared. Your medical team handles treatment and medication questions.

en.guideClose: For example: I’m going through fertility treatment and looking for individual therapy. Do you offer sessions in Serbian? What is the fee, and when is your next available appointment?

sr.title: Psihološka podrška tokom lečenja neplodnosti i IVF-a u Schaumburgu
sr.description: Podrška tokom neplodnosti i vantelesne oplodnje na srpskom i engleskom. Dr Jelena Đurović, Schaumburg i onlajn seanse za klijente koji se nalaze u Ilinoisu.
sr.intro: Dok čekate rezultat ili razmišljate o novom pokušaju, posao i svakodnevne obaveze ne staju. Nekad je teško i razgovarati sa partnerom, posebno ako ne želite isti sledeći korak. Dr Jelena Đurović pruža individualnu i partnersku terapiju tokom lečenja neplodnosti u ordinaciji Center for PTA u Schaumburgu.

sections.title: O čemu možete da razgovarate
sections.text: Povod može biti negativan rezultat, gubitak trudnoće ili umor od lečenja. Možda sebe krivite za ono što se desilo ili ne znate šta da kažete porodici. Za razgovor sa psihologom ne morate da čekate da se lečenje završi.

sections.title: Da li partner mora da dolazi sa mnom?
sections.text: Ne. Možete da dolazite sami i ako kroz lečenje prolazite zajedno. Partnerska terapija je posvećena vašem odnosu, na primer svađama koje se ponavljaju ili neslaganju oko nastavka lečenja. Kada se javite, recite da li želite individualne razgovore ili partnersku terapiju.

sections.title: Kako da se javite
sections.text: U prvoj poruci ukratko napišite zbog čega se javljate i pitajte za termine. Nije potrebno da šaljete detaljnu istoriju lečenja. Pre zakazivanja proverite cenu, osiguranje i da li želite da dolazite sami ili sa partnerom.

sections.title: Na srpskom ili engleskom, uživo ili onlajn
sections.text: Razgovori su dostupni na srpskom i engleskom, u ordinaciji na adresi 1320 Tower Rd, Suite 156, Schaumburg, IL 60173. Za onlajn seanse svi učesnici moraju da budu fizički u Ilinoisu tokom razgovora. Sa doktorkom se dogovarate i da li je onlajn rad odgovarajući za vas.

sections.title: Cena, osiguranje i medicinsko lečenje
sections.text: Pogledajte stranicu sa cenama i osiguranjem, pa proverite pokriće psihoterapije sa ordinacijom i osiguravajućom kućom. Za psihoterapiju mogu da važe drugačiji uslovi nego za lečenje neplodnosti. O medicinskom lečenju i lekovima razgovarajte sa lekarom koji vas leči.

links.title: Stres zbog neplodnosti i partnerski odnos

sr.guideTitle: Kako izabrati psihološku podršku tokom lečenja neplodnosti
sr.guideIntro: Pre zakazivanja proverite iskustvo terapeuta, cenu i kako izgledaju seanse. Ovih pet pitanja možete da pripremite za taj razgovor.

questions.title: Da li radite sa ljudima koji prolaze kroz lečenje neplodnosti?
questions.text: Recite zbog čega se javljate, na primer zbog stresa tokom lečenja, gubitka trudnoće ili teškoća u odnosu sa partnerom. Pitajte terapeuta da li ima iskustva u radu sa tim problemom i kako bi mu pristupio.

questions.title: Mogu li da dolazim bez partnera?
questions.text: Proverite da li terapeut radi individualno, sa parovima ili oba. Ako biste počeli sami, a kasnije uključili partnera, pitajte kako bi se tada promenio rad i šta ostaje poverljivo.

questions.title: Možemo li da razgovaramo na jeziku koji mi odgovara?
questions.text: Dogovorite jezik razgovora pre zakazivanja. Za onlajn terapiju proverite u kojim državama terapeut može da radi sa klijentima i da li takve seanse odgovaraju vašim potrebama.

questions.title: Koliko košta i kada bismo mogli da počnemo?
questions.text: Pitajte koliko košta seansa, da li je pokriva vaša polisa i koliko biste plaćali iz svog džepa. Proverite prvi slobodan termin i pravila otkazivanja.

questions.title: Kako izgleda prvi razgovor?
questions.text: Pitajte da li treba nešto da pripremite. Ako želite da psiholog razgovara sa klinikom u kojoj se lečite, proverite kakva saglasnost je potrebna i koje informacije bi se razmenjivale. Pitanja o medicinskom lečenju i lekovima ostaju za vašeg lekara.

sr.guideClose: Na primer: Prolazim kroz lečenje neplodnosti i želela bih individualne razgovore. Da li radite na srpskom? Koliko košta seansa i kada imate slobodan termin?
